summary.id: Backend real-time untuk tongkat pintar IoT bagi penyandang tunanetra: MQTT, sesi perjalanan di Redis, dan notifikasi darurat lewat FCM. Proyek skripsi saya.
summary.en: A real-time backend for an IoT smart cane for visually impaired people: MQTT, trip sessions in Redis, and emergency alerts through FCM. My thesis project.
